name: Jeush
overview: Jeush was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, known specifically as the son of Bilhan. Beyond this direct familial link, Scripture provides no further details or notable events associated with him. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeush is a proper name that likely means 'may God aid,' reflecting a hopeful or prayerful sentiment. This meaning is derived from the Hebrew and is noted in 1 Chronicles 7:10. There are no titles or additional names associated with him.
familyAndRelationships: Jeush is explicitly identified as the son of Bilhan, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. No other family relationships are recorded in Scripture beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jeush's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as documented in 1 Chronicles 7:10. His mention contributes to the biblical record of tribal lineage, which is important for understanding the heritage and identity of Israel's tribes. While not prominent in narrative events, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the descendants of Benjamin.
